summary: Full backend (pytest, 28 passed / 1 xfail) and frontend e2e (registration, login, logout, forgot-password, OT creation with status, user isolation, export menu) testing for the new JWT-auth + status + pagination features. Found 1 CRITICAL backend bug (seeded admin email rejected by EmailStr) and 1 UX issue (toast overlaps user-menu-button).

critical.issue: Pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects '.test' as a reserved/special-use TLD, returning 422. The seeded admin (admin@local.test / admin123 in backend/.env) therefore CAN NEVER LOG IN. Reproduce: curl -X POST $URL/api/auth/login -d '{"email":"admin@local.test","password":"admin123"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' => 422 'The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name'. Fix options: (a) change ADMIN_EMAIL in backend/.env to admin@local.dev or admin@example.com and rerun seed_admin (note: seed_admin already supports updating password, but only finds by current ADMIN_EMAIL); (b) keep raw 'str' for LoginRequest.email (not EmailStr) and validate manually; (c) enable email_validator with allow_special_use=True / test_environment=True. Same problem will affect ANY user who registers with a .test/.invalid/.localhost address.

ui_bugs.issue: The toast notification (¡Cuenta creada! / ¡Bienvenido! / Orden de trabajo creada) is rendered in the top-right corner and visually OVERLAPS the user-menu-button (40x40 at ~x=1696,y=20). During the 4s the toast is visible the avatar/dropdown trigger is effectively unclickable (Radix DropdownMenu doesn't open on pointerdown when the toast overlay intercepts pointer events). Reproduce: register a user, immediately try to click the avatar -> menu doesn't open until the toast disappears. Fix: reposition toaster to top-center or bottom-right, or offset top-right toaster below the header bar (e.g. `<Toaster position="top-center"/>` or `offset={{ top: 80 }}`).

On wrong password the page stays on /login (correct) but no visible error/toast was rendered in our test (no element with role=alert / class*=destructive / class*=error appeared). Confirm whether errors are shown via Sonner toast (which could be missed/transient).

issues: Header right cluster (Exportar + avatar) is partially covered by the success toast on first load; consider repositioning the toast or compressing header.
When dashboard has 0 OTs, the empty state still allows opening 'Filtros'/'Exportar' — fine, but exporting empty list could be disabled.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Fix admin login: change backend/.env ADMIN_EMAIL to a non-reserved TLD (e.g. admin@local.dev) OR loosen EmailStr usage in LoginRequest/RegisterRequest. After changing, re-run seed_admin so it inserts/updates the new admin record. Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md accordingly.
[MEDIUM] Reposition Sonner Toaster so it does not overlap user-menu-button (use position='top-center' or add top offset).
[LOW] Confirm error feedback on invalid login is visibly rendered (toast/error). Consider an inline error message component for clearer UX.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py / server.py - LoginRequest and RegisterRequest both use EmailStr from email-validator which rejects reserved TLDs (.test, .localhost, .invalid). This conflicts with the documented default admin email admin@local.test and will surprise developers/testers. Either change the seed email or relax validation for these models.

server.py seed_admin - The function only updates the admin doc whose email == ADMIN_EMAIL. If an operator changes ADMIN_EMAIL to fix the .test issue, the previous admin doc with the old email will become orphaned. Consider cleaning up or making seed idempotent across renames.
Sonner Toaster default position (top-right) collides with the header avatar; place the <Toaster/> with explicit position prop or move the avatar elsewhere.
Dashboard.js line 205-270 - two adjacent DropdownMenus (Export and User) in the same header — fine, but increases the risk of overlay conflicts with the toaster.

auth.py - good: bcrypt is used (hashes start with $2b$), security answer is hashed + trim + lowercase normalized, brute-force lockout works (returns 429 after 5 fails), httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookies are set as needed for the HTTPS preview.

Backend pagination envelope is consistent ({items,page,page_size,total,total_pages}); status filter validates allowed values and returns 400 on invalid; PDF export returns valid %PDF bytes with content-type application/pdf; Excel export includes 'Estado' column. All user-scoping checks (GET/PUT/DELETE/reorder) correctly return 404 for cross-user access.

success_rate.backend: 97% (28/29 pytest cases passing; 1 xfailed for admin@local.test login - real bug)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (registration, login, dashboard, OT create with status, status badge, export menu, isolation, forgot-password reset+case-insensitive answer all PASS; logout-via-UI temporarily blocked by toast overlap)

test_credentials: Seeded admin admin@local.test/admin123 is DEFINED in backend/.env but CANNOT log in due to EmailStr validation. Created during tests: TEST_*@example.com users (pass1234) and e2e_*_<ts>@example.com users (pass1234).
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_REG_*, TEST_A_*, TEST_B_*, TEST_RESET_*, TEST_LOCK_*, e2e_user1_*, e2e_a_*, e2e_b_*, e2e_log_* users were created in Mongo. Some test work-orders are cleaned up via fixtures; lockout-locked TEST_LOCK_* users remain in DB until lockout expires.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes the admin email TLD bug, retest: (1) curl /api/auth/login with the new admin creds returns 200 and sets cookies; (2) /app/memory/test_credentials.md is updated; (3) the toast no longer covers user-menu-button (visual + functional click on avatar opens dropdown immediately after register/login). All other backend/frontend behavior already verified - re-run /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_workorders.py for regression.
rca of the issue: EmailStr in pydantic delegates validation to the email-validator package, whose default config rejects RFC-2606 special-use TLDs (.test, .localhost, .invalid, .example). Since both LoginRequest.email and RegisterRequest.email are typed EmailStr, the seed admin 'admin@local.test' is rejected before reaching the password check, returning HTTP 422. The admin is correctly written to Mongo at startup (bcrypt hash $2b$...) but is unreachable through the public auth endpoints. Mitigation: change ADMIN_EMAIL to admin@local.dev (or admin@example.com which is allowed) OR replace EmailStr with a custom validator that accepts reserved TLDs.
